scenes.title_cn: 荷兰式倾斜角度：会让画面产生轻微的失…
scenes.title_en: Dutch tilt: it creates a slight sense of i…
scenes.context: 荷兰角制造紧张失衡的叙事感。
sentences: 这个镜头叫荷兰式倾斜角度。
This shot is called the Dutch tilt angle.
Dutch tilt（荷兰式倾斜）
会让画面产生轻微的失衡感和紧张感。
It creates a slight sense of imbalance and tension.
sense of tension（紧张感）
让观众下意识看得更专注。
It makes viewers unconsciously watch more intently.
watch more intently（看得更专注）
scenes.speak: This shot is called the Dutch tilt angle. It creates a slight sense of imbalance and tension. It makes viewers unconsciously watch more intently.

scenes.title_cn: 仰拍与俯拍：从下往上拍会让人物看起来…
scenes.title_en: Low angle and high angle: shooting from be…
scenes.context: 角度决定人物的气场和情绪。
sentences: 从下往上拍会让人物看起来更强更有气势。
Shooting from below makes the subject look stronger and more imposing.
low angle（仰拍）
连你的猫从这个角度看都像个超级英雄。
Even your cat looks like a superhero from this angle.
looks powerful（显得强大）
从上往下拍会让人物显得更柔和更乖巧。
Shooting from above makes the subject look softer and gentler.
high angle（俯拍）
也能营造出情绪的焦虑感和无力感。
It can also create anxiety and a sense of helplessness.
sense of helplessness（无力感）
scenes.speak: Shooting from below makes the subject look stronger and more imposing. Even your cat looks like a superhero from this angle. Shooting from above makes the subject look softer and gentler. It can also create anxiety and a sense of helplessness.

scenes.title_cn: 过肩镜头：这个镜头会让观众瞬间代入，…
sentences: 下一个镜头是过肩镜头。
The next shot is the over-the-shoulder shot.
over-the-shoulder（过肩镜头）
这个镜头会让观众瞬间代入，好像站在你身边一起看世界。
It instantly immerses the audience, as if seeing the world beside you.
instantly immerse（瞬间代入）
scenes.speak: The next shot is the over-the-shoulder shot. It instantly immerses the audience, as if seeing the world beside you.

scenes.title_cn: 超特写：能把任何细节变成主角，像是一…
scenes.title_en: Extreme close-up: it turns any detail into…
scenes.context: 超特写聚焦细节与关键时刻。
sentences: 超特写能把任何细节变成主角。
Extreme close-up turns any detail into the hero.
extreme close-up（超特写）
像是一种吸睛的情景感，也能突出动作或物体的关键瞬间。
It creates an eye-catching intimacy and highlights the key moment.
key moment（关键瞬间）
scenes.speak: Extreme close-up turns any detail into the hero. It creates an eye-catching intimacy and highlights the key moment.

scenes.title_cn: 总结：每一种镜头角度都有它自己的意义…
scenes.title_en: Summary: every camera angle has its own me…
sentences: 每一种镜头角度都有它自己的意义和情绪传达。
Every camera angle carries its own meaning and emotion.
carry emotion（传达情绪）
用对了你的画面会更有故事感。
Used right, your frame becomes more cinematic.
more cinematic（更有故事感）
scenes.speak: Every camera angle carries its own meaning and emotion. Used right, your frame becomes more cinematic.

practice: The Dutch tilt adds imbalance and tension.
Low angle makes the subject look powerful.
The over-the-shoulder shot immerses the viewer.
Extreme close-up turns detail into the hero.
pitfalls: Tilt the camera randomly for effect.
Use the Dutch tilt to create tension and imbalance.
荷兰角是为紧张感服务，不是随便倾斜。
Use low and high angles to control power and mood.
仰俯拍分别传达强势与柔和。
过肩镜头让观众瞬间代入。
Use extreme close-ups to highlight key moments.
超特写把细节变成主角。
shifts: 用 Dutch tilt（荷兰角）、low/high angle（仰俯拍）、over-the-shoulder（过肩）
用 tension（紧张感）、helplessness（无力感）、intimacy（亲密感）
用 cinematic（故事感）、carry emotion（传达情绪）、key moment（关键瞬间）
